episodes.title: Just You Wait and See
episodes.summary: In Nazi-occupied Paris, Christian Dior fears for his resistance-fighter sister, Catherine. Coco Chanel makes a deal that will forever haunt her.

episodes.title: The Hour
episodes.summary: Christian embarks on a quest to free Catherine from German captivity. Coco is sent on an undercover mission and recruits her friend Elsa.

episodes.title: Nothing But Blue Skies
episodes.summary: Coco suffers the consequences of her relationship with Spatz. Christian's pursuit of Catherine takes a fatal turn.

episodes.title: What a Difference
episodes.summary: After Paris is liberated by Allied troops, Nazi collaborators face punishment—including Coco. Christian is conflicted about ever designing again.

episodes.title: Give Your Heart and Soul to Me
episodes.summary: Christian is offered a job that will forever change the course of his life. Coco struggles with her outsider status as she's self-exiled in Switzerland.

episodes.title: If You Believed in Me
episodes.summary: Desperate to stand up to her business partners, Coco begins a war over her most famous perfume. Christian must redefine his relationships.

episodes.title: It All Came True
episodes.summary: Christian takes unexpectedly bold and daring next steps to launch his fashion house. Coco figures out how to use Elsa's "talents" to her advantage.

episodes.title: I Love You Most of All
episodes.summary: Coco hosts a world-famous fashion editor in the hopes of helping orchestrate her comeback. Christian faces family pressure from his father.

episodes.title: Will You Return
episodes.summary: Christian tends to family matters that will forever influence his aesthetic. Coco must make a deal with Spatz as Elsa's addiction intensifies.

episodes.title: What a Day This Has Been
episodes.summary: Season finale. Christian's major decision puts his first fashion show in danger. As Coco confronts her partners, Spatz threatens her freedom.
